text:
ashley: Heads-up — found a case where pins weren't evicted after tenant migration, caused requests to route to old variant for ~18h. Repro steps + logs below. Need a short playbook for stale-pin detection + rollback window.

ryan: ugh. can you paste the relevant logs?

ashley: pasted snippet from proxy logs:
```
INFO route=proxy tenant=acme pin_id=pin:abc lease=2024-11-13T08:12:34Z returned_variant=old-v1 cache_hit=true kv_seq=784
```

lina: quick q — are these pins hard locks or soft unbinds? I thought we migrated everything with soft-unbind semantics.

ashley: soft unbinds. the bug seems to be controllers not updating lease_ttl on migration, so last_seen stayed recent and stale heuristics missed it.

dev-ex-bot: Suggestion: emit a derived metric stale_score = (now - last_seen_ts) / lease_ttl_seconds and fire when stale_score > 1.0; also tag by rollout_cohort_id.

ryan: +1. I also propose adding two helpful metadata fields: "stale_score" (float, computed) and "provenance_chain" (structured list of ops that produced the pin) to help triage.

lina: minimal schema proposal (additive): rollout_cohort_id, lease_ttl_seconds, last_seen_ts, owner_hint, provenance_chain, stale_score, rollback_window_seconds. Keep it compact so client stubs don't need changes.

ashley: example pin metadata (inline example):
```json
{ "rollout_cohort_id":"c-53", "lease_ttl_seconds":"86400", "last_seen_ts":"1700000000", "owner_hint":"deploy-team-platform", "provenance_chain":"rev:123->migration:456", "stale_score":"0.0" }
```

ryan: small nit: provenance_chain should be an array of short entries for machine parsing, not a single string. e.g. ["rev:123","migration:456"]. Also default rollback_window_seconds = 7200 (2h) seems reasonable but configurable per-tenant.

lina: fallback behavior proposal: if stale_score > 1.5 -> route a percentage of traffic (probe) to fallback model to validate behavior and emit an alert; if stale_score > 3.0 -> mark pin for auto-evict after a manual review window (e.g., 1h). This reduces noisy auto-evicts while still protecting correctness.

ashley: ops playbook draft (short):
1) Alert: stale_score > 1.0 for any tenant pinned variant.
2) Run dry-run eviction (dry-run flag logs expected route changes, no immediate evict).
3) If dry-run passes automated checks, schedule eviction job with rollback_window_seconds applied.
4) If regressions detected, revert rollout_cohort (or route back to previous cohort).

ryan: telemetry: add labels pin.origin, pin.migration_id, pin.owner, pin.rollout_cohort. Log pin transition events to the event-store (insert events: pin.created, pin.migrated, pin.evicted) with timestamps. That will help reconstructions.

lina: compatibility note: make fields additive; clients that don't understand new keys ignore them. ensure our client-stub continues to parse pins when unknown keys present.

ashley: action items: ashley -> draft PR with schema + ops playbook; ryan -> telemetry event + alert rules; ops-bot -> add stale_score alert rule and create INF ticket. target: EOW.

ops-bot: noted :white_check_mark: creating issue #INF-1287 and assigning to @ashley @ryan.

ashley: thanks — I'll start the PR and include an example migration test that asserts lease_ttl updates on migration and stale_score recomputation.

ryan: I'll add a small sim harness to fuzz different lease_ttl distributions and confirm sensible default thresholds.

lina: ok. once PR is up ping #eng-oncall for quick review on the alert thresholds.

ops-bot: scheduled reminder: ping #eng-oncall in 48h if INF-1287 still open.
